Enthusiasm and comfort are essential for education, so I create and foster a joyful and welcoming learning space from the very first greeting.

I have five years of online tutoring experience, beginning in 2019. My initial focus was on Japanese students and learners primarily from Asia. Currently, I teach English and Spanish to learners of all ages, backgrounds, and nationalities.

I have both prepared for and helped others prepare for the IELTS. I hold an overall score of 8 in the IELTS Academic.

My goal is to honor individuality, making each learning journey as unique and valuable as the student.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My strength lies in conversational lessons, though I also have a wide and growing experience with grammar, reading, and writing-focused classes. Lessons can include learning materials, varied websites, videos, music, art, mine or those the student provide, or proceed without them, depending on preference.

I like to constantly revisit the dictionary with the student, to strengthen vocabulary and grammar.

I emphasize writing during lessons to create support material for review. Each session is one-on-one, fostering a bidirectional exchange where the student becomes the teacher, and I can also be the student.

course_info.trial_description:

If you only have the will to learn, together we can find what suits you best. Do you want to improve your grammar, writing, reading, listening, comprehension, or communication skills? Let's figure that out and start learning, whether in a conversational lesson or a more formal one.

If your goals are well defined, let's start right away. I will adapt to your preferences, objectives, and requirements. Together, we will respond to the dynamics of the lesson and formulate a plan of action.

Some like to break the ice, while others prefer to warm things up nice and slowly. Either way, we will arrange the learning space to be cozy and engaging.

🏝️ Living in Caracas, I’d love to share insights about my city and Caribbean life.
😆 In my classes, you’ll find a fun, open-minded, and engaging teacher.

All I ask in return? A smile 😃.

📺 I share my screen to show you text, videos, or anything that helps you understand better.
